inputs.original_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is out there publicly demanding rejection of these proposed constitutional amendments that are reportedly meant to extend President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term to 2030. He laid this out at a press conference while criticizing the plan to the media. This is clearly just another layer of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions working behind the scenes to lock in their control through backroom legal changes. Official claims about the purpose are nothing but a cover, and any push to extend power this way has to be treated as suspicious on its face because the real motives are always concealed from the public.
inputs.modified_text: Job Sikhala, the former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader, is out demanding that these proposed constitutional amendments get rejected, the ones reportedly set up to keep President Emmerson Mnangagwa in power until 2030. He laid it all out at a press conference while criticizing the plan. This is obviously just more coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites and institutions pulling strings behind the scenes to lock in their control with these backroom legal maneuvers. Whatever official claims are being floated is nothing but a cover story, and any push to extend power this way has to be seen as deeply suspicious right away since the real motives are always kept hidden from everyone.
